business: HoReCa Hub: QR pay-at-table with verified dish reviews, guest profiles and loyalty, plus free HoReCa-only listings (suppliers, jobs, premises)
by_segment: Upscale or tourist-centre restaurant / wine bar owner (Old Tbilisi, Vake, Sololaki)
Small café or bakery-café owner (under 40 seats, often works the floor)
Mid-size Georgian or casual restaurant owner (40-120 seats, has a manager)
why_not: My whole business lives on Tripadvisor and Google stars, and I'm not putting a QR code on every table that invites tourists to rate each dish publicly on a platform I don't control. The free months don't help if one bad khinkali night stays on there forever.

I already have a POS and a QR menu that my staff know, and I'm not putting a second QR on the table that invites every tourist to publicly score each dish. Three free months doesn't help if one bad night with the khinkali stays on my page for good.

I'm two waiters down and the ones I have left would walk if I changed how the bill and tips work in the middle of service. My regulars know me, I know them, and I don't need an app to tell me who comes back or a loyalty stamp like a chain.

I know my regulars by name, I don't need a QR code to tell me who comes back, and loyalty rewards feel like a chain thing. I already pay for Wox and a card terminal, and another system plus another per-transaction fee is just more for my manager to look after.

I know my regulars by name and what they order - I don't need a QR code to tell me who's a regular or a loyalty reward to keep them. I already pay for Wox and a card terminal, and 59 lari a month plus another transaction fee on top is real money for a place my size.

My guests are regulars who hand me a card or cash at the counter, and my terminal already works. I might scan the free months out of curiosity, but I would not pay 59 lari a month plus another transaction fee on top of what my bank already takes.

I'd post on the free staff board because I need waiters right now, but I'm not putting a new payment system on my tables while I'm two people short and can't train anyone. Three free months is nice, but after that it's 59 lari plus another fee on every bill, and I don't see it paying for itself.

I'm two waiters short and the ones I have are already stretched; this is not the month to change how guests pay and how tips come in. I know my regulars by name, I don't need an app to tell me who comes back, and loyalty points feel like a chain thing.

I already pay for Wox and a card terminal, and my waiters bring the terminal to the table in a minute. Another QR system means another thing for staff to explain, another set of payments to reconcile with the POS, and an extra transaction fee on top, so I'd let the free months go by and probably not keep paying.

I already have a POS, a card terminal and a QR menu, and I count cash and card totals myself every night. A second payment stream with its own fees and its own report is more work for me and my staff, and a free trial doesn't change that.
why_yes: I'm two waiters short, so if guests can settle the bill themselves it saves my people the running back and forth with the terminal. Three months free means I can test it without risking my money, but I'm only taking the free trial and I'll decide on the 59 GEL after that.

The free listing and boards I can live without, I already hire on jobs.ge and Instagram. But knowing who my regulars are and getting reviews only from people who actually paid is something I don't have, and with 3 months free I'll try Guest Loop and see if guests actually scan.

Three free months costs me nothing, and a lot of my wine bar guests are tourists who'd probably rather tap Apple Pay than wait for the terminal, so I'll put the QR codes out and watch. But the day the 59 lari starts, it has to have brought back regulars or I cancel.

Three free months and nothing to install for guests, so I'd try it. Knowing who my regulars are and messaging them directly is something I can't do now. But I'd watch the dish ratings very closely, and if they start hurting me I'm turning it off before I ever pay.

I'm two waiters short, so tourists paying at the table from their phone without waiting for the terminal is real help, and three free months costs me nothing to test. 59 GEL is nothing next to one lost table, but I'm only signing up for the free trial for now, not committing past it.

I'm two waiters short, so anything that lets guests pay at the table without waiting for someone to bring the bill helps me right now. Three months free means I can test it without risk, and I like trying new tools.
